The color of an eggplant is purple.

The competitor's new loyalty program poses a significant threat to our business. By integrating discounts, rewards, and personalized experiences directly into their mobile app, they are creating a high-friction barrier to switching for their existing customers. This strategy is likely to increase their customer retention rates while actively eroding our market share. To mitigate this impact, we must urgently evaluate our own customer engagement strategies, potentially by accelerating the development of a comparable digital loyalty ecosystem or enhancing our unique value propositions to differentiate ourselves from their personalized approach.
